headline: Demand grows, but slower than the fleet

drivers.title: AI capex boom
drivers.line: Servers and chips lifted the WTO's 2026 trade forecast from 1.9% (Mar) to 3.9% (Oct).

drivers.title: Trade re-routing
drivers.line: Cargo redirected, not destroyed: strong Asian exports, Chinese pivot to Africa and South America.

drivers.title: Tariff front-loading
drivers.line: Retailers pulled orders forward ahead of new tariff deadlines.

risks.title: Hormuz and oil
risks.line: A long closure and high oil prices could cut 2026 growth to 0.5–1.3% (Drewry).

risks.title: Tariff payback
risks.line: Front-loading now means an inventory hangover and a restocking slump later.

risks.title: AI capex cooling
risks.line: A slowdown in AI investment removes a main pillar of trade growth (WTO: risks high).
